about.title: About
paragraphs: I am a PhD candidate in Public Governance, Management and Policy at the University of Bologna, with a joint scholarship between the Department of Statistical Sciences and the Department of Agricultural and Food Sciences. My research focuses on food behaviours and the synergies between health and sustainability.

I am currently a visiting PhD researcher at Copenhagen Business School in the Consumer and Behavioural Insights Group. I work at the crossroads of statistics, semiotics, and sustainability: modelling food choices and designing data-informed strategies to reduce food waste and support healthier, more conscious decisions. Since 2023 I have also tutored courses in data mining and market analysis at UniBo.
